name: Multi-Attribute Consistency (MAC) Loss
definition: An objective that jointly regularizes the 3D attributes of matched Gaussians, including position, shape, and appearance, by enforcing agreement in a common world coordinate frame. It is robust to outliers and respects the geometry of covariance matrices.
summary: MAC loss is a regularization objective for 3D Gaussian Splatting that enforces geometric and photometric agreement between matched Gaussians across views to solve sparse-view ambiguity.
